profile.headline: Lead Software Developer (Full-Stack)
profile.summary:
Technical Lead with more than 15 years of experience and familiar with all phases of the SDLC, CI/CD, and Agile practices. I enjoy writing scalable code, learning new technologies, and finding easy solutions to complex problems.

My most recent experience includes working with Angular, React, and .NET Core.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
At TLC, my team is responsible for the suite of applications and services necessary to create and amend the Texas Legislation and support the legislative process. All applications are built in-house using C#, Angular, .NET Core, .NET Framework, and integrations with enterprise-level solutions. We work in a highly collaborative environment to ensure the success of our clients during the legislative session.   

My primary responsibilities include:

• Leading the architecture, design, and development of new applications (front-end and back-end). 
• Making strategic trade-offs between technical and business needs; finding pragmatic solutions that balance technical elegance with time-to-market. 
• Working collaboratively with business analysts, quality assurance, and leadership to define the scope of projects. 
• Working with other Tech Leads to create the technical roadmap for the entire organization. 
• Increasing the quality of legacy applications by refactoring specific parts of the code to introduce concepts like Dependency Injection, Unit Tests, Design Patterns,  and the SOLID principles. 
• Mentoring junior engineers and providing strategic guidance to senior engineers.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Automated the process of filing legislative Bills 
• Enhanced and supported complex legacy Windows applications written in C#
• Upgraded the MS Word Document Generation Engine to support .docx (instead of .doc).
• Upgraded a document search engine from Verity to Autonomy IDOL. 
• Replaced legacy printing logic by creating PDFs programmatically

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Created web applications and websites to support internal and external clients, including features like processing online payments, tracking electric power usage, and providing a CMS to their IT department to manage the contents of the site.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Traveled to different customer locations in the US and India to develop, deploy, integrate, and customize software solutions
